description: This PHP source file defines the Helpers class within the PhpSpreadsheet Calculation DateTimeExcel namespace. It provides various static utility methods for date and time calculations, conversions, and manipulations used in spreadsheet calculations, including leap year detection, date adjustments, format conversions, and date parsing.

classes.name: Helpers
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for date and time calculations, conversions, and manipulations within the PhpSpreadsheet calculation engine.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines if a given year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDateValue
methods.description: Converts a date value (object, string, or number) to an Excel serial date number, with validation.

methods.name: getTimeValue
methods.description: Converts a time string to an Excel serial time value.

methods.name: adjustDateByMonths
methods.description: Adjusts a date by a specified number of months and returns the resulting DateTime object.

methods.name: replaceIfEmpty
methods.description: Replaces a variable's value with an alternative if it is empty.

methods.name: adjustYear
methods.description: Adjusts the year in ambiguous date situations based on provided string values.

methods.name: returnIn3FormatsArray
methods.description: Returns date data in one of three formats: PHP DateTime object, Excel serial number, or UNIX timestamp based on configuration.

methods.name: returnIn3FormatsFloat
methods.description: Returns a float date value in one of three formats based on configuration.

methods.name: returnIn3FormatsObject
methods.description: Returns a DateTime object or its equivalent in other formats based on configuration.

methods.name: baseDate
methods.description: Provides the base date offset depending on calendar compatibility mode.

methods.name: nullFalseTrueToNumber
methods.description: Converts null, false, or true values to numeric date serials, considering allowance for boolean values.

methods.name: validateNumericNull
methods.description: Validates that a value is numeric or null, converting null to zero.

methods.name: validateNotNegative
methods.description: Ensures a number is numeric and not negative.

methods.name: silly1900
methods.description: Adjusts a DateTime object if it predates March 1900, as a workaround for Excel's date system.

methods.name: dateParse
methods.description: Parses a date string into an array of date components.

methods.name: dateParseSucceeded
methods.description: Checks if date parsing succeeded based on error count.
